title: The 10 Best DIY Home Security Systems
subtitle: Alarm kits with sensors, keypads, and sirens you install yourself, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the DIY home security kits on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: optional professional monitoring, cellular backup, and smart home support.
systems_note: Ring, SimpliSafe, and Abode all have official Home Assistant integrations. Smart Life alarms work with Home Assistant's Tuya integration.

buyers_guide.a: No. Most kits send phone alerts and sound a siren for free. Paid monitoring adds a call center that dispatches police or fire, and some insurers offer a discount for it.
A base station with a siren, a keypad, door and window sensors, and a motion sensor. Larger kits add more sensors and range extenders.

buyers_guide.q: Will it work if the internet goes down?
buyers_guide.a: The base station's siren still works. Some systems include a cellular backup that keeps alerts going, usually on a paid plan.
